counting.note: award_count / unique_awards = distinct awards in the warehouse profile. Summing per-FY award counts double-counts awards with actions in multiple years. recent_* rows are obligation actions (often modifications), not unique awards.

set_asides.note: Historical set-aside codes observed on warehouse award actions. last_observed_action_fy is the latest action FY for that code (may be a deobligation) — not award origin. award_origin_fy is the earliest positive-obligation FY when established; otherwise null (unknown). Neither field is current SAM certification status or a graduation/exit reason. Aggregated across warehouse award actions for this UEI (not derived from the capped recent_awards sample).
